title: Minimum payments on all debts
summary: Same as W-2 — minimum payments are sacred until you are deliberately accelerating.
detailsHtml: The contractor twist: business debt (line of credit, equipment loans) and personal debt should be tracked separately because business debt interest is typically deductible as a business expense, lowering its effective cost. A 9% business line of credit at the 24% bracket has an after-tax cost closer to 6.8% — still high, but less brutal than the headline rate.
